text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm f-finally done… Why is it that when I clean, things just get messier?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Oh, h-huh? Where is this… place? Why… am I here?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uugh… The Th-Three Goddesses must hate me…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm always spacing out and causing a mess… Just why have I turned out like this?
